court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
trial_court: Chief Judicial Magistrate, Lucknow (Criminal Case No.237 of 2020)
case_name: Vivek Prakash And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home. Lko

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Vivek Prakash And Another (husband and another)
parties.respondent_defendant: State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home. Lko (government) And Another

facts_of_case: Petitioner's wife filed a case under Sections 498-A, 504, 506, 406 IPC and Section Dowry Prohibition Act. Parties arrived at a compromise.

legal_principles.principle: Parties' compromise can lead to quashing of proceedings.
legal_principles.held: Since the parties have arrived at a compromise, the proceedings in respect of cases mentioned at serial nos.1, 2 and 4 are liable to be quashed.
cited_cases: Vivek Prakash And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home. Lko ... on 16 August, 2022

legal_principles.principle: Conversion of divorce petition is possible with parties' agreement.
legal_principles.held: In view thereof, the parties shall appear before the Family Court concerned on 24.8.2022 and file necessary pleadings to convert the petition filed under Section 13 of Hindu Marriage Act.

outcome.final_order: Proceedings in respect of cases mentioned at serial nos.1, 2 and 4 are liable to be quashed. Divorce Case No.137 of 2021 filed by the petitioner shall be converted as proceedings under Section 13-B Hindu Marriage Act.
